It may be used for the prevention of vitamin K deficiency in patients with malabsorption syn- dromes in whom oral phytomenadione may be ineffi- ciently absorbed. It is given in usual doses equivalent to 10 to 40 mg of menadiol phosphate daily by mouth. Menadiol dibutyrate has also been used; mena- tetrenone is used in the management of osteoporosis.
